abilities.effect: A spike launches along the trip line’s path against the triggering creature, making a ranged Strike.
abilities.name: Spike
abilities.trigger: A creature crosses one of the trip lines

traits.name: Range
traits.text: These attacks will either list a finite range or a range increment, which follows the normal rules for range increments.

hazard.description: A jagged spike of metal shoots from a hidden launcher.
hazard.disable: DC 16 Thievery to disable one of the four launchers or DC 12 Acrobatics to step over a trip line (this doesn’t disarm the trap, but avoids triggering it)
hazard.name: Spike Launcher

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
